The '''Demophon Supernova''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]]. The star [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] was known to be unstable, and the [[Demophon Stellar Monitor Station]] was established to monitor it. The observatory was sabotaged, so the impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] was not discovered until a few weeks before its occurrence, far too late to evacuate the entire population. When the star exploded it destroyed all habitation in the system.<ref name="SN" />
